description: Released originally in 2017, VHOOR is thrilled to re-release "Desce Vai" featuring Mc Britney. The track exemplifies the "Chill Baile" era of that time, where up-and-coming producers experimented with Baile Funk vocals to create soulful versions and remixes of their favorite tracks. 7 years after its original release, the song still sounds fresh without loosing any relevancy.
credits:
Produced by: VHOOR
Vocals by: Mc Britney
